summary: Select kit Storybook lanes when the production thread and browser-pairing dependencies bundled by workspace stories change.

replay.detail: CI input classification and regression checks only; no replay or projection changes.

rules.detail: No permission or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No runtime API or protocol changes. Kit coverage adds exactly nine bundled source files and retains the dependency-closure guard. Generated hosted detectors carry the same classification; regression coverage requires the embedded source to match the tested detector.

downtime.detail: No service changes or downtime required.

recovery.detail: No data migration or recovery action required.
